name: connect-1k-databricks-credentials-refresh
description: What: After a Databricks credential change in the CrewChief secrets: reset to the baseline, re-import 'Service Configuration Databricks' (picks up the new secret), back up the baseline. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: workloads it runs: connect-database-reset, connect-service-configuration-databricks-refresh, connect-database-backup. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.
globalParametersNotes: SourceTableName is the table every size's source backup holds; every shared child reads it from here.

inline.description: What: Restore the PDATA baseline and check the source data load strategy reads PDATA. Why: Runs the child workload 'connect-database-reset' so its tested steps are reused here, not repeated. Success: The child workload ends with every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Open the run output of 'connect-database-reset'; its first failed step says what to check.

What: Delete and re-import 'Service Configuration Databricks'. Why: Runs the child workload 'connect-service-configuration-databricks-refresh' so its tested steps are reused here, not repeated. Success: The child workload ends with every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Open the run output of 'connect-service-configuration-databricks-refresh'; its first failed step says what to check.

What: Back up Main as the baseline. Why: Runs the child workload 'connect-database-backup' so its tested steps are reused here, not repeated. Success: The child workload ends with every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Open the run output of 'connect-database-backup'; its first failed step says what to check.
